Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, Derangements

While you strongly dislike and refuse to take part in torture, you believe that killing is your divine duty, and that hiding behind the Masquerade even while killing goes against God's will that you reveal yourselves as the angels of death you are.

Trigger/Effect: Each time you kill, you make sure your victim knows exactly what you are first.
